text:
sam: morning—apocalypse update: last night's thunderstorm fried our neighborhood's fiber. no warning, router fried? my ISP shipped a replacement but it's stuck in transit. for now i'm running zoom calls off my phone hotspot and duct-taped a lamp to the router to keep it dry? send help. also cat approved of the box. pic: IMG_2987.jpg
rachael: oh no. hotspot throttling already? how's latency for you?
sam: ping wise it's ok (~70ms) but upload is 0.8Mbps. shared screen is a slideshow. will try `--disable-hd` on my camera (jk).
omar: if you need, i can switch our standup to async today. also duct tape is valid engineering solution :thumbsup:
ben: i got a mesh system gathering dust if you want to borrow it — lives in my garage 2 blocks away. happy to drop off during lunch.
sara: also, pro tip: enable 'low data mode' in Zoom settings and turn off incoming video. it helps with limited bandwidth.
dev-bot: Reminder: random channel polls today — are you on or off for midday coffee run? :coffee:
sam: off, unless someone wants to carry my router and a ficus. offer stands.
rachael: lol ive got a ficus but no router. offer declined.
omar: :crying_cat_face: poor router. post-pic please when rescue mission accomplished.
sam: uploaded IMG_2987.jpg — cat inside the router box, lamp duct-taped, and my 'emergency' travel router (TP-Link) on the chair. caption: 'field mode'
